eligibilityData.waitingPeriodText: The period applicable to this record under Neb. Rev. Stat. § 29-3523(3) has run, or its trigger has occurred.
additionalFacts: The criminal history record information identified above remains publicly available notwithstanding the sealing duty imposed by the Security, Privacy, and Dissemination of Criminal History Information Act.
Petitioner is a person aggrieved by that failure to comply, and brings this action under Neb. Rev. Stat. § 29-3528 to compel compliance.
Petitioner elects to bring this action in this district under the venue provision of Neb. Rev. Stat. § 29-3528.

Petitioner describes the circumstances of the continued public availability of the record in the accompanying statement; that statement is completed by Petitioner and is not supplied by any other person.
